org.tmt.aps.peas.instrument.model

Class Ccd

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.instrument.model.Ccd

  • @Entity
public class Ccd
extends Object
    Instrument configuration Entity class representing the Ccd database table. Also contains transient fields for CCD state and temperature. Hot pixel lists are encoded strings in the database. This class encodes and decodes hot pixel lists from the database.
    Author:
    smichaels
